answer: Assembling that for 99 aliases means 99 times 3 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each cipher escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the bridge ledger records every share and the zenith audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 3 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
